name: Harm Echo
description: Catch a light blow on the forearm and send its echo back at the striker.

name: Rebound Palm
description: Strike with an open palm at the moment the foe's blow lands so the two forces meet.

name: Return Glance
description: Glance at the foe and feel how much of the harm they dealt is still owed to the user.

name: Pay Step
description: Step in on the heel of a missed blow to pay the miss back at close range.

name: Interest Strike
description: Hand back the harm just taken with a small added weight that bites through the guard.

name: Rebound Guard
description: Hold a wall that throws part of every blow it takes back along the striker's arm.

name: Thread Sight
description: See the faint thread between a foe and the last harm they did and follow it to its other end.

name: Thread Pluck
description: Pluck the thread so that a foe's next move stumbles on its own wrongdoing.

name: Karmic Screen
description: Draw a thread round the body that turns back the harm of anyone who has none owed to the user.

name: Karma Stride
description: Step along a thread to the very spot where its last strike landed.

name: Thread Mark
description: Tie a mark on the foe's thread so that the user's next blow knows where to fall.

name: Thread Tie
description: Wind the thread round a foe's limbs and tie it fast to the wrong they just did.

name: Thread Tug
description: Tug the thread hard so the foe is pulled off balance into a waiting blow.

name: Lien Touch
description: Lay a lien on the foe's qi with a touch so a part of it is no longer theirs to spend.

name: Binding Mote
description: Throw a mote that sticks to the foe and drags at them with the weight of their wrongs.

name: Owed Guard
description: Raise a guard that holds firm only against those who owe the user harm.

name: Pledge Sense
description: Feel whether a person has broken a pledge and how heavily it weighs on them.

name: Debt Chain
description: Cast a chain of owed harm round a foe that tightens with each blow they throw.

name: Collect Strike
description: Strike to collect a part of what the foe owes and draw a share of their qi away.

name: Merit Glow
description: Let the warmth of past good deeds rise as a glow that steadies the user's hands.

name: Kind Return
description: Return a small good to an ally who once did the user a kindness and ease their pain.

name: Boon Touch
description: Touch an ally's shoulder and pass on a measure of the user's earned luck.

name: Fair Step
description: Step with the evenness of a clear conscience and meet no snag on the way.

name: Merit Sense
description: Feel how much good a person has done and how much of it is still unpaid to them.

name: Boon Share
description: Share the user's stored merit with the nearby allies so that each fights with a lighter heart.

name: Absolve
description: Lift a taint of guilt or a minor curse from an ally by taking its weight onto the user's own merit.
